entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • completion make it hard to use an undeclared generic type parameter as return value #75651
    18.4
  • Analyzer suggestion: unnecessary use of `unsafe` #48031
    Backlog
  • Replace uses of `Locations[0]` and `Locations.First()` #29707
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio Go To Definition issue with relative paths in the miscellaneous workspace #79014
    18.1
  • Roslyn fails to load newer version of strong-named analyzer DLL #60446
    Backlog
  • CS1591 triggers for protected internal methods when it should not #80822
  • C# VS 2022 Code Style | Formatting | Spacing not properly applying options #60981
    Backlog
  • C# Refactor actions missing for removing redundant else statements #60385
    Backlog
  • How are duplicate values in IncrementalValuesProvider handled? #60287
    Backlog
  • [Questions] Several questions about source generators #60256
  • Add Diagnostic ID column for Code Style/Whitespace/Naming Style in EditorConfig UI #60147
    Backlog
  • 'EnableNullableCodeRefactoringProvider' encountered an error and has been disabled #59758
    Backlog
  • When creating a new project, the dialog should suggest popular roslyn analyzers to include. #59620
    Backlog
  • Support feed-forward type hinting for the binding process #59139
    Backlog
  • Confusing surperflouos error message involving partial methods and out #80816

Updated

  • StackOverflowException in EndToEndTests.Constraints caused test failure #45815
    Backlog
  • Extensions: diagnostic quality follow-ups #78830
    18.3
  • ITypeSymbol.BaseType docs appear to be incorrect wrt Type Parameters. #41733
  • Test plan for "collection expression arguments" feature #80613
    .NET 11
  • Source generators: projectreference #60964
  • Need 'fix-all' for naming style violations. #14983
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix handling of SymbolDisplayCompilerInternalOptions.UseArityForGenericTypes option for non-native symbol implementations #80826
    Area-Compilers
  • Removing seemingly unnecessary data from cache #80825
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove unused statement #80823
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix rename conflict detection for local functions and lambdas #80821
    VSCode
  • Unify raw string lexing and parsing #80817
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • soft-select select camelcase matched item if user might be typing an … #80809
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add analyzer/fixer to remove unnecessary 'unsafe' modifiers from members. #80794
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Allow semantic tokens in Razor to be better behaved #80815
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Merge main to features/collection-expression-arguments #80824
    VSCode
  • Update code to use GetFirstLocation() instead of Locations[0] or Locations.First() #80709
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • When searching for the original file from a PDB, only allow absolute paths #80804
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Extensions: address some diagnostic quality issues #80827
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fbp live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Improve error reporting for 'with(...)' argument diagnostics. Address several PROTOTYPE comments. #80805
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Add regression tests for Interlocked.Exchange with null checks #80802
    Area-Compilers, Test
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Target-Typed New
  • Update documentation for DeclaringSyntaxReferences and Locations to clarify partial members behavior #80704
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Test
  • Ensure that locals at the top level of a constructor have the same safe-context as parameters #80807
    Area-Compilers
  • Add XML documentation for GlobalStatementSyntax #80697
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Add test demonstrating behavior of ToMinimalDisplayString. #80757
    Area-Compilers, Test
  • Copilot: Fix culture-sensitive StringBuilder.Append calls across codebase #80800
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Allow foreach on typed null enumerables #80783
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error message for record inheritance without parameter list #80795
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix SyntaxFactory.Identifier to throw ArgumentNullException instead of NullReferenceException #80699
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix SyntaxNode.Ancestors() to work correctly with structured trivia #80786
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix await keyword recognition in interpolated strings with parentheses #80763
  • Improve error recovery for => in constructor initializers #80764
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error messages for keywords used as identifiers in LINQ let clauses #80695
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: Add ReduceExtensionMember API #80659
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Improve documentation and error message for InsertTokensBefore/After and ReplaceToken methods #80691
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve arity error message to prefer generic type when both generic and non-generic exist #80707
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix superfluous managed address errors for pointer to non-existent type #80760
    Area-Compilers
  • Add explicit logging when DOTNET_HOST_PATH is not found in BuildServerConnection #80739
  • Cache lambdas in analyzer driver #80759
    Area-Analyzers, Area-Compilers
  • Add tests verifying pointer types in type parameters require unsafe context #80776
    Area-Compilers
  • Add regression test for ParseAttributeArgumentList with invalid input (fixes #8699) #80705
    Area-Compilers
  • Add regression test for compiler crash with syntax error in indexer declaration #80772
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ArgumentException in SeparatedSyntaxList.ReplaceSeparator to use proper message and paramName #80690
    Area-Compilers
  • Mark CS4009 error as a "build only" error. #80698
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Add regression test for Interlocked.Exchange with nullable types #80796
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix IsSymbolAccessibleWithin to respect EmbeddedAttribute #80681
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality
  • Fix NullReferenceException in VB SyntaxFactory.ParseArgumentList when parentheses are missing #80803
